title: Hades
description: Fight out of the underworld as the prince Zagreus in a fast action roguelike where every escape attempt builds the story.

title: Celeste
description: A tough but generous platformer about climbing a mountain and facing self-doubt along the way.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
description: Explore a huge open Hyrule with the freedom to tackle the story in almost any order.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: A story-driven fantasy RPG following monster hunter Geralt as he searches for his adopted daughter.

title: Stardew Valley
description: Inherit a run-down farm and build a new life growing crops, raising animals and befriending the townspeople.

title: Hollow Knight
description: Explore a vast, interconnected underground insect kingdom full of tough bosses and secrets.

title: Portal 2
description: A first-person puzzle game built around placing portals, with sharp humor and a co-op campaign.

title: Minecraft
description: Build, mine and survive in a blocky, procedurally generated world.

title: Elden Ring
description: A challenging action RPG set in the sprawling Lands Between.

title: Undertale
description: An RPG where you can finish fights without killing, and your choices change how the story plays out.
